# 🌀 VortexBlueprints — Blueprint Marketplace & Creator Economy

> **Players capture builds. Sell them. Earn royalties forever.**
> The most complete blueprint economy system ever built for Paper and Folia.

---

## ✨ What Is VortexBlueprints?

VortexBlueprints transforms your server into a **living creator marketplace**. Players select any structure with a wand, publish it as a blueprint, set a price and license type, and start earning royalties **automatically** every time another player builds their design.

It's not just a schematic tool. It's a full creator economy — with originality protection, team revenue splits, moderation queues, analytics dashboards, rating GUIs, dispute resolution, Discord notifications, and a built-in web panel for remote moderation.

---

## 🚀 Core Features

### 🏗️ Blueprint Capture & Publishing
- Select any cuboid region with the **VortexBlueprints wand** or `/vbp pos1` / `/vbp pos2`
- Publish with a price, category, license type, build style, royalty rate, and description
- Rotation-aware placement so builds always face the correct direction
- Preview footprint before committing a build

### 🛒 Global Marketplace
- Full **inventory GUI marketplace** with six browsing views:
  - 🌟 Featured · 📈 Trending · 🆕 Newest · 💰 Cheapest · 💎 Profitable · 👑 Top Creator
- Category filtering: `house` `spawn` `farm` `pvp` `redstone` `shop` `dungeon` `medieval` `scifi` `decor`
- One-click buy, build, preview, rate, and inspect — all from the GUI

### 🔒 Originality Engine
- Every blueprint is **fingerprinted** at capture time
- Similarity scoring compares the new build against all existing listings
- Exact duplicates are blocked. Near-copies are flagged for review. Original builds go live instantly.
- Players can open disputes against listings they believe are derived from their own work

### 💸 Economy & Royalties
- Vault-compatible with a **built-in credit wallet fallback** — no economy plugin required
- Per-listing royalty percentage paid on every build
- **Team ownership system** — split revenue across multiple co-owners with configurable share percentages
- Milestone progression system with badge rewards

### 🎨 Build Styles
| Style | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `instant` | Entire structure placed at once |
| `animated` | Chunked paste over multiple ticks with visual feedback |
| `drone` | Animated paste with drone-style particles |
| `crate` | Crate-opening particle and sound effect during paste |

### 📜 License Types
| License | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `single_use` | One build per purchase |
| `pack_five` | Five builds per purchase |
| `pack_twenty` | Twenty builds per purchase |
| `showcase` | Limited display use |
| `exclusive` | One buyer, listing archived after sale |

### ⭐ Ratings & Analytics
- GUI-based rating flow — quality, accuracy, and usefulness scoring
- Rate from `/vbp rate <id>` **or** directly from the blueprint detail GUI
- **Creator analytics GUI** — revenue, royalties, views, purchases, conversion rate, badges, top categories, timeline

### 🛡️ Moderation
- Review queue GUI for pending originality approvals
- Dispute queue GUI for active originality challenges
- `/vbp probe protection` — live diagnosis of all claim hooks at any location
- Built-in **web panel** for remote review and dispute resolution
- **Discord webhook** notifications for publications, milestones, reviews, and disputes

### 🔌 Protection Integrations
WorldGuard · Towny · Lands · GriefPrevention · Residence · PlotSquared

### 📡 Developer API
Fire-and-listen Bukkit events:
- `BlueprintPublishEvent`
- `BlueprintPurchaseEvent`
- `BlueprintBuildCompleteEvent`
- `RoyaltyPaidEvent`

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|-------------|---------|
| Server | Paper or Folia 1.21.x |
| Java | 21+ |
| Economy | Vault (optional) |
| Storage | SQLite (default) or MySQL |

---

## 📖 Commands (Quick Reference)

/vbp wand → Get the selection wand
/vbp save <id> <price> → Publish a blueprint
/vbp market → Open the marketplace GUI
/vbp build <id> → Build a blueprint
/vbp rate <id> → Open the rating GUI
/vbp analytics → Open creator analytics
/vbp review gui → Open the moderation review queue
/vbp panel → Print the web panel URL

---

Full setup, configuration, API reference, and moderation guide:

*Build. Sell. Earn. — VortexBlueprints*
